# Introduction

The **`jjsegmentedtotalbar`** analysis (Segmented Total Bar Charts) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Create segmented total bar charts (100 percent stacked bars) that show proportional  breakdowns within categories. Perfect for displaying composition data where  each bar represents 100 percent and segments show relative proportions.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("jjsegmentedtotalbar_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::jjsegmentedtotalbar(
#   data = jjsegmentedtotalbar_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `jjsegmentedtotalbar` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
